title: ESQL: Support queries that don't return underlying fields

timeline.message:
ESQL: Support queries that don't return underlying fields

Improve ProjectAwayColumns rule to take into account queries that don't
 return the actual values of the underlying data rather just care about
 the number of entries returned.

Fix #98404

timeline.body: Hi @costin, I've created a changelog YAML for you.

This is the gist of the fix - previously the case was detected by removing all the attributes and thinking that if there are no attributes, there's a projection in place - which clearly is not the case.
Hence why the fix is to introduce a separate flag and actually consider the list independently.

reply.body: nit: why not skip `skipProject` and just move the block inside the `if (logicalFragment instanceof Aggregate) {` branch?

timeline.body:
Send as data a dummy null block which will contain as many entries as the count.
To avoid a clash with existing projections, use the synthetic flag.

reply.body: nit: your explanation on why the synthetic flag needs to be used would make a great comment in the code IMO :)

timeline.body: Break the method a bit to make it usable inside CSVTests.
Remove the local duplicated code and use the same code from PlannerUtils.
I just moved this method above the utility methods, alongside the rest of the tests.
